name: treemap
title: Treemap
description: Compare hierarchical values using nested rectangles whose area follows each value.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from "vue";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "motion-v";
import {
  autoUpdate,
  computePosition,
  flip,
  offset,
  shift,
  type VirtualElement,
} from "@floating-ui/dom";
import { SPRING_PANEL } from "../lib/ease";
import { resolveElement, useReducedMotion } from "../lib/composables";
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    open: boolean;
    anchor: HTMLElement | null;
    id: string;
    point?: { x: number; y: number };
    side?: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left";
    followCursor?: boolean;
  }>(),
  { side: "top", point: () => ({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }), followCursor: false },
);
const emit = defineEmits(["update:open"]);
const popup = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);
const position = ref({ x: 0, y: 0 });
const ready = ref(false);
const reduce = useReducedMotion();
const mounted = ref(false);
let generation = 0;
let pointer: { x: number; y: number } | undefined;
let disposeLayout: (() => void) | undefined;

function element() {
  return resolveElement<HTMLElement>(popup.value);
}
function reference(anchor: HTMLElement): VirtualElement {
  return {
    contextElement: anchor,
    getBoundingClientRect() {
      const box = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x =
        props.followCursor && pointer
          ? pointer.x
          : box.left + box.width * props.point.x;
      const y =
        props.followCursor && pointer
          ? pointer.y
          : box.top + box.height * props.point.y;
      return {
        x,
        y,
        left: x,
        right: x,
        top: y,
        bottom: y,
        width: 0,
        height: 0,
        toJSON: () => ({}),
      };
    },
  };
}
async function place() {
  const tooltip = element();
  const anchor = props.anchor;
  const current = generation;
  if (!mounted.value || !props.open || !tooltip || !anchor) return;
  const result = await computePosition(reference(anchor), tooltip, {
    placement: props.side,
    strategy: "fixed",
    middleware: [offset(10), flip(), shift({ padding: 8 })],
  });
  if (
    current !== generation ||
    !mounted.value ||
    !props.open ||
    element() !== tooltip
  )
    return;
  position.value = { x: result.x, y: result.y };
  ready.value = true;
}
watch(
  [mounted, () => props.open, () => props.anchor, popup],
  async (_, __, cleanup) => {
    const current = ++generation;
    disposeLayout?.();
    disposeLayout = undefined;
    ready.value = false;
    cleanup(() => {
      generation++;
      disposeLayout?.();
      disposeLayout = undefined;
    });
    if (!mounted.value || !props.open || !props.anchor) return;
    await nextTick();
    const tooltip = element();
    if (current !== generation || !tooltip || !props.anchor) return;
    disposeLayout = autoUpdate(props.anchor, tooltip, () => {
      void place();
    });
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);
watch(
  () => [props.point.x, props.point.y, props.side, props.followCursor],
  () => {
    void place();
  },
);
watch(
  [mounted, () => props.anchor],
  ([isMounted, anchor], _, cleanup) => {
    pointer = undefined;
    if (!isMounted || !anchor) return;
    const move = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (event.pointerType === "touch") return;
      pointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
      if (props.open) void place();
    };
    const leave = () => {
      pointer = undefined;
    };
    anchor.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
    anchor.addEventListener("pointerleave", leave);
    cleanup(() => {
      anchor.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
      anchor.removeEventListener("pointerleave", leave);
    });
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);
function dismiss(event: PointerEvent) {
  if (!props.open || !(event.target instanceof Node)) return;
  if (
    !props.anchor?.contains(event.target) &&
    !element()?.contains(event.target)
  )
    emit("update:open", false);
}
function escape(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (props.open && event.key === "Escape") emit("update:open", false);
}
onMounted(() => {
  mounted.value = true;
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", dismiss);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", escape);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  mounted.value = false;
  generation++;
  disposeLayout?.();
  document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", dismiss);
  document.removeEventListener("keydown", escape);
});
</script>

<template>
  <AnimatePresence>
    <motion.div
      v-if="open"
      :id="id"
      ref="popup"
      role="tooltip"
      class="pointer-events-none fixed top-0 left-0 z-50 max-w-64 rounded-xl border border-border bg-popover px-3 py-2 text-xs text-popover-foreground shadow-lg"
      :initial="{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }"
      :animate="{
        opacity: ready ? 1 : 0,
        scale: 1,
        x: position.x,
        y: position.y,
      }"
      :exit="{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }"
      :transition="
        reduce
          ? { duration: 0 }
          : { ...SPRING_PANEL, opacity: { duration: 0.12 } }
      "
      ><slot
    /></motion.div>
  </AnimatePresence>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_OUT, SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useTreemap } from "./context";
import type { TreemapTile } from "./model";
const props = defineProps<{ tile: TreemapTile }>();
const chart = useTreemap();
const bounds = computed(() => ({
  left: (props.tile.x / chart.size.width) * 100 + "%",
  top: (props.tile.y / chart.size.height) * 100 + "%",
  width: (props.tile.width / chart.size.width) * 100 + "%",
  height: (props.tile.height / chart.size.height) * 100 + "%",
  backgroundColor: props.tile.color,
  color: props.tile.textColor,
  borderRadius: "8px",
}));
const accessibleName = computed(() =>
  [
    props.tile.path.join(" / "),
    chart.formatValue(props.tile.value),
    (props.tile.share * 100).toFixed(1) + "% of total",
    props.tile.description,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(". "),
);
const tabIndex = computed(() =>
  chart.tiles.findIndex((tile) => tile.id === props.tile.id) ===
  Math.max(
    0,
    chart.tiles.findIndex((tile) => tile.id === chart.activeId),
  )
    ? 0
    : -1,
);
function activate() {
  chart.setActive(props.tile.id);
  chart.tooltipOpen = true;
}
</script>
<template>
  <motion.button
    type="button"
    :data-tile="tile.id"
    :layout="!chart.reduce"
    :tabindex="tabIndex"
    :aria-label="accessibleName"
    :aria-describedby="
      chart.tooltipOpen && chart.activeId === tile.id
        ? chart.tooltipId
        : undefined
    "
    class="absolute overflow-hidden border-2 border-background text-left outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-white"
    :style="bounds"
    :initial="{ opacity: 0 }"
    :animate="{ opacity: 1 }"
    :exit="{ opacity: 0 }"
    :transition="{
      layout: chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT,
      opacity: { duration: 0.18, ease: EASE_OUT },
    }"
    @pointerenter="chart.canHover && activate()"
    @pointerdown="activate"
    @click="activate"
    @focus="activate"
    ><motion.span
      aria-hidden="true"
      :layout="chart.reduce ? false : 'position'"
      :transition="chart.reduce ? { duration: 0 } : SPRING_LAYOUT"
      class="absolute inset-x-2 top-2 min-w-0 sm:inset-x-3 sm:top-3"
      ><slot :tile="tile"
        ><template v-if="tile.width >= 52 && tile.height >= 32"
          ><span class="block truncate text-xs font-semibold sm:text-sm">{{
            tile.label
          }}</span
          ><span
            v-if="tile.width >= 70 && tile.height >= 56"
            class="mt-1 block truncate font-mono text-[10px] tabular-nums opacity-80 sm:text-xs"
            >{{ chart.formatValue(tile.value) }}</span
          ></template
        ></slot
      ></motion.span
    ><motion.span
      aria-hidden="true"
      class="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-white/10"
      :initial="false"
      :animate="{
        opacity: chart.tooltipOpen && chart.activeId === tile.id ? 1 : 0,
      }"
      :transition="{ duration: 0.1, ease: EASE_OUT }"
  /></motion.button>
</template>
